login.subtitle: The internal communication app for instructors.
login.otpHint: You will receive a 6-digit sign-in code by email.
login.error: No account found for this email address. Accounts are created by an admin or superadmin.
login.noSignup: No self-registration — accounts are created by an admin or superadmin.
login.codeSentTo: We sent a 6-digit sign-in code to {{email}}.
login.codeError: Wrong or expired code. Request a new one if needed.
login.codeHint: The code and your session are valid until midnight — you stay signed in unless you sign out.
login.sandboxCode: Sandbox: your code is {{code}} — in production it arrives by email.

home.subtitle: What would you like to open?
home.installHint: iPhone/iPad: add this app to your home screen to receive notifications.
home.installStep1: Open the app in Safari and tap the Share icon.
home.installStep3: Confirm with “Add” — the app then opens full-screen and can receive notifications.

chat.title: Chat
chat.noGroups: You are not a member of any group yet.
chat.noMessages: No messages yet — or they have already been auto-deleted.
chat.changeHint: One vote per person — changeable until the poll is closed.
chat.blockedNote: You have been blocked from sending in chat by an admin. You can still read messages. Please contact your administrator.
chat.pollValidHint: Date and time are in UTC. After this time the poll closes automatically.

chatInfo.title: Chat info
chatInfo.retentionNote: Messages in this group are automatically deleted after this period.
chatInfo.attachmentNote: Attachments are deleted together with their message.

info.permanentNote: Entries in this library are permanent — chat auto-deletion does not apply here.
info.ufnHint: Leave "Valid until" empty for UFN (until further notice).
info.confirmDelete: Delete this entry for all users?
info.requiresAck: Read confirmation required (each user must confirm)
info.groupsHint: No selection = visible to everyone. With groups selected, only their members see the entry — and only they must confirm reading.
info.scheduled: Scheduled — not yet visible to the target groups

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.intro: Your feedback goes by email to the selected recipient.
feedback.identity: Sent with your name: feedback is not anonymous. {{name}} ({{email}}) will be visible to the recipients.
feedback.sentBody: Your feedback was sent and stored for the admins.
feedback.errorEmpty: Please choose a recipient and enter a message.

admin.title: Admin Panel
admin.confirmDeleteGroup: Delete this group including all messages?
admin.imprintHint: Formatting: “# ” starts a new section with a heading, “- ” a bullet line, blank lines separate paragraphs. Changes take effect immediately for all users.
admin.desktopOnly: The Admin Panel is available on desktop only — on tablets and phones the administration would be too cramped. Please open it on a computer.
admin.userGroupsHint: Every person must belong to at least one group. Groups control chat access and Instructor Info visibility.
admin.emailLoginHint: The email address is the only sign-in credential — sign-in is by email only.
admin.permMatrixHint: The superadmin always has every permission. Members are controlled via the flags on each user (“May grade”, “May edit Who to call”). This matrix defines what the Admin and Training Admin roles are allowed to do — changes take effect immediately.

perm.grading_create: Fill in and send grading forms
perm.info_manage: Create and manage Instructor Info entries
perm.contacts_manage: Edit the Who to call directory

admin.lastGroupBlocked: Every user must belong to at least one group — otherwise they lose access to chats and group-scoped Instructor Info. Assign a different group first.

imprint.title: Legal notice & terms of use
imprint.stand: As of: August 2026 · Instructor Connect version {{version}}

sandbox.banner: SANDBOX — test mode, no real data

grading.noPermission: You are not enabled to fill in grading forms. An admin can change this in user management.
grading.signHint: Sign with your finger or a stylus.
grading.lockNote: Once both parties have signed, the form is locked read-only. Corrections require a new entry referencing the original.
grading.readOnlyNote: This form is signed and therefore read-only.
grading.followUpBody: The result is “Not Competent” or the session was not completed. Which forms apply?
grading.errNoTrainee: Please enter a name for every student.

admin.trendHint: A competency graded low across the fleet points to a systemic training gap.
admin.competencyHint: Competencies and observable behaviours apply to all forms of the respective set. Changes take effect for new forms immediately.
admin.calibrationHint: Deviation from the overall average. Values from ±0.50 are highlighted and indicate systematically harsher or milder grading.
admin.exportHint: Unprocessed raw data for audits, separated by training, competencies and people.
admin.deferredRecipients: Form 310 recipients (Deferred Item List) — always notified
admin.deleteCompetencyConfirm: Delete this competency? It disappears from new forms; existing records keep their grades.
admin.newFormHint: New form types get the standard header fields (aircraft type, date, event, training device, flight times). Existing forms keep their data if a type is deleted.
admin.deleteFormTypeConfirm: Delete this form type? It disappears from the selection for new forms; existing forms keep their data.

grading.attendance307B: With the signature, the instructor/examiner confirms the participation of all individuals listed to the full extent and within the specified timeframe of the respective event.
grading.footnote1: * Tick if two or more competencies are graded with 2 or below; refer to Form 306 – Additional Training.
grading.footnote2: ** Tick if one or more required items are not completed; describe not completed items in the comment box and Form 310, Deferred Item List.
grading.footnote3: *** Ready for skill test to be signed on Form 311.
grading.errGradeComment: {{name}}: a comment is mandatory for every competency graded 1 or 2.
grading.errComments: {{name}}: positive aspects, development areas and summary are mandatory.
grading.autoNotCompetent: Automatically Not Competent: one or more competencies graded “1”, or two or more graded “2”.
grading.sessionDataHint: These items are always entered after the grading, at the end of the session.
grading.sigLiveNote: Signatures are never stored or carried over — whenever a signature is required, it must be given live on this device.
grading.retentionHint: Grading sheets remain visible in your view for one week after creation. Admins keep the full record permanently.
grading.deleteOwnConfirm: Remove this grading sheet from your view? It remains stored for admins.
grading.deferredMailNote: Form 310 (Deferred Item List) is always emailed to the Training Admin upon completion: {{recipients}}
grading.multiStudentHint: Multiple students in one pass are for convenience only: each student signs individually, and on completion a SEPARATE form is created for each student.
grading.extraRecipientsHint: Standard recipients are configured by the admin. Additional recipients apply to this form only.
grading.sendBlocked: Sending is only possible once the form is complete and correct — still open:
grading.followUpBodyMandatory: The result is “Not Competent” or the session was not completed. The forms marked as mandatory MUST be completed now — the originating grading sheet is attached to their email dispatch automatically.
grading.followUpMailNote: Each follow-up form is emailed to the configured recipients together with the originating grading sheet.
grading.followUpWarn: A mandatory follow-up form has not been completed for this grading sheet yet:
grading.mailAttachment: The originating grading sheet ({{form}}) is automatically attached to the email dispatch of this form.
grading.printHintBody: To save this form as a PDF, tap the button below and choose “Save as PDF” or a printer in the dialog.
grading.printShareFallback: If no dialog opens: use the browser Share menu and choose “Print” there.
grading.trainingAdminNote: Training Admin access: you can view and download all completed and open forms. Creating or removing forms is not possible.

lessons.title: Title
lessons.empty: No lesson plans available for your assigned aircraft types.
lessons.noAircraft: No aircraft type has been assigned to you yet. An admin can change this in user management — afterwards you will see the matching lesson plans.
